[Verse 1]
[A]Dashing through the snow, In a
one horse open [D]sleigh,
O'er the fiels we [E]go,
Laughing all the [A]way.
Bells on bob tail ring,
Making [D]spirits bright;
What fun it is [A]to ride and sing
[E]A sleighing song [A]tonight. [E]Oh

[Verse 2]
[A]day or two ago, I-
thought I'd take a [D]ride, And
soon Miss Fannie [E]Bright was
Sitting by my [A]side. The
horse was lean and lank, Mis-
fortune seemed his [D]lot,
He got into a [A]drifted bank and
[E]Whee!, he got [A]upsot! [E]Oh!

[Verse 3]
[A]Now the ground is white,
Go it while you're [D]young.
Take the girls [E]tonight and
Sing this sleighing [A]song. Just
get a bobtail bay, Two
forty for his [D]speed. Then
hitch him to an [A]open sleigh and
[E]Crack, you'll take the [A]lead! [E]Oh!
